notes:
【实验版】改动较大，可能有未发现的问题。不想升级可以点更新卡片上的「稍后再说 / ✕」。
朗读服务的地址更不容易填错：中文输入法敲出的全角字符（HTTP：／／…）会自动规整；地址无效时直接提示，不再显示成「请求失败（无响应）」。
本机地址（127.0.0.1、localhost）始终直连：Wi-Fi 上配了代理时，跑在手机上的朗读服务也能连上。
深链配置给内置服务换地址时必须同时带上 Key，确认卡片只列出真正会写入的内容。
Inworld 的音色列表跟随所填的服务地址。
修复：Key 被拒绝后改回正确的 Key，状态仍停在「API Key 被拒绝」；连接失败后再次打开面板会重新确认。
notesEn:
[Experimental] Bigger changes; there may be undiscovered issues. To skip it, tap the X on the update card.
Server addresses are harder to get wrong: full-width characters typed with a Chinese keyboard are normalized, and an invalid address now says so instead of showing "Request failed (no response)".
Loopback addresses (127.0.0.1, localhost) always connect directly, so a speech server running on the phone works even when Wi-Fi has a proxy set.
External configuration can point a built-in service at another address only when it also carries a key; the confirmation card lists exactly what will be saved.
Inworld's voice list follows the address you set.
Fixed: after a rejected key was corrected, the status stayed on "API key rejected". A failed connection check is now retried when the panel is reopened.
